event_annotations.notes: Evidence derived from programmatic scan of Exp3/Subj30_S01_Exp3.mat and Exp3/Subj30_S03_Exp3.mat showing Experimental_states struct with TargetCode (values 0,1), ResultCode (value 0), Feedback (values 0,1), CursorPosX, and CursorPosY. All 126 .mat files follow identical structure per filename pattern (SubjX_SYZ_ExpZ.mat across 3 experiments × 3 sessions). No events.tsv or sidecar files exist; event markers are embedded state variables in continuous sample-by-sample arrays. TargetCode transitions between 0 and 1 indicate target absence/presence. Feedback transitions between 0 and 1 indicate feedback period state changes. ResultCode remains 0 in sampled data, suggesting incomplete trials or placeholder value. Cursor position variables (0 to 2047 range) encode continuous tracking state. Experiment_Parm contains timing parameters (PreFeedbackDuration, PostFeedbackDuration, ITIDuration) that contextualize state transitions. Confidence is 'inferred' because direct mapping documentation is absent and interpretations derive from variable naming conventions and value patterns rather than explicit documentation.
